translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

book.name: Apocalipsis
book.title: Jesucrístona' bliile' Juanna' c̱he diika' zi' gak

content: Ka biyoll bzej' diika' wne' nad', na' ble'do'id' nyalj to puert xan yabana'. Na' bizenid' bishbena' daa benid' dii nech daa nen ka ga chbell to trompet, na' wne' nad': ―Nilə wyep, na' wliid' li' diika' zi' za' gak.
Na' ka wṉie' nad', Espíritu c̱he Chioza' bene' ka ble'id' yabana' gana' llia to beṉ' chṉabi'e.
Na' beena' llia na', chey cheeni'chgue' ka yaj wan daa le jaspe na' daa le cornalina. Na' tcho'a tlawi gana' llie' ze to betyaa na' chṉa'titan ka yaj wan daa le esmeralda.
Na' gana' llie', ble'id' nec̱hj zi tapichoa beṉ' lliagake' chṉabia'gake', na' zoagake' do xtil na' nzoa twej corona de or yic̱hje'ka'.
Na' gana' llia beṉ' necha' chep yes, na' chashj chtin, na' chak sshag inlleb. Na' lawe'na' ze gall yi' chaḻ'ṉiṉan na' ḻegakannan' espírituka' gall c̱he Chioza'.

Ḻekzka' lao beena' llia chṉabia' de to dii nak katekzə nisdo'na' na' nakan ka de vidr. Na' gchoḻ gana' chi'e chṉabi'e lle' tap beṉ' de yeḻ' mban c̱heyin, na' dii zan jalaogake' llia, ka laoləgake' na' ka koll'ləgake'.
Beṉ' necha' nake' ka bell, na' beṉ' wchopina' nake' ka gooṉ, na' beṉ' wyoṉina' nak cho'alawe'na' ka c̱he beṉec̱h, na' beṉ' wdapina' nake' ka bsia, ba chzo.
To to beṉ'ki zoa x̱op wej x̱ilgake', na' zoa dii zan jalaogake' ka ḻoolə na' ka koll'lə x̱ile'ka'. Na' bi chsangake' ka waḻ ka tella nagake':

content.text: Dowalj beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao', dowalj beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao', dowalj beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao', nak X̱ancho Chioza',
beena' nap yeḻ' wak choo yeḻ' wak xen,
beena' zoa ka wxe wzil yell-liona',
na' ḻekzen' zoe' ṉaa, na' zoakze' zejḻi kaṉi.

content: Na' beṉ'ka' tap chgoogake' balaaṉ beena' llia chṉabia', beena' mban zejḻi kaṉi. Na' choe'gake' xtillee nake' beṉ' zakii nlleb na' choe'gake'ne' yeḻ' chox̱ken. Na' to to ka chongake' ka',
beṉ'ka' tapichoa chc̱hek' xibe'ka' lao beena' mban zejḻi kaṉi na' choe'la'ogake'ne'. Na' chzaḻ'gake' corona c̱he'ka' lawe'na', nagake':

content.text: Chios, li' nako' X̱annto', na' chidoḻoo koonto' li' balaaṉ na' we'nto' xtilloo nako' beṉ' zakii nlleb,
na' beṉ' yeḻ' wak choo yeḻ' wak xen.
Lin' bx̱e bsilo' yog'ḻoḻte dii de,
na' daa goklalloo soagakan, bx̱e bsilgako'n.
